data.title: Tottenham vs Coventry City Prediction, Lineups & Team News | RotoWire
data.content:
Predicted lineups: Tottenham are projected in a 4-2-3-1, with Bergvall alongside Tonali for the suspended Bentancur and Micky van de Ven expected to return at centre-back in place of Marcos Senesi. Archie Gray is projected at right-back with Pedro Porro out. Coventry are also expected to use a 4-2-3-1, the same back four and double pivot they used against Newcastle, with Awoniyi coming in up front for Sidiki Cherif and Jack Rudoni playing behind him. [...] With Porro out, Tonali, who took three corners at Old Trafford, and Savinho are the likeliest to deliver Tottenham's dead balls, and Solanke and Kudus are the penalty options in the projected XI with Marmoush outside it. Wright is injured, so Awoniyi is the first-listed taker if he starts, although Rudoni scored the penalty against Newcastle while Awoniyi was suspended.

## Tottenham vs Coventry City Prediction [...] Tottenham should have the stronger attacking positions between the lines. Gallagher can operate behind Coventry's midfield, while Kudus and Savinho can move inside from wide areas and force Grimes and Yirenkyi to defend more than one threat at a time.

Coventry still have a route into the game. Bentancur's suspension makes Tottenham's midfield less secure, and Awoniyi gives Lampard a more experienced focal point for transitions into the space behind Udogie and Gray.
